description_en: Starts stopped cloud computers. After the API operation is successfully called, the cloud computers enter the Running state
description_zh: 启动一台或者多台已停止的云电脑。接口调用成功后，云电脑进入运行中状态
kebab_example: aliyun ecd start-desktops --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-7w78ozhjcwa3u0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartDesktops

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer IDs. You can specify the IDs of 1 to 100 cloud computers
parameters.name: desktop_id
